"""Submit preserved production checkpoints only after all recovery gates pass."""
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess
r=pathlib.Path('/scratch/jr7309/runs/2026-10-08-early-fine-rtx/recovery-observation-cache')
producer='8c9a7403edbcd3a37fe09c3af687cbb99a62be85'
receipt=r/'production-submission.json'
if receipt.exists():raise FileExistsError('Production already submitted; inspect receipt before any retry')
p=json.loads((r/'paths.json').read_text());assert p['producer']==producer
code=r/'source'/producer
migration=json.loads((r/'MIGRATION_COMPLETE.json').read_text())
assert not migration['scientific_changes']
arms=['U-multitask-early','U-multitask-early-latent','U-multitask-early-fine','U-multitask-early-fine-latent']
assert json.loads((r/'performance/COPIES_VERIFIED.json').read_text())['copies_verified']==arms
accounting=subprocess.check_output(['sacct','-X','-n','-j','19425444','--format=JobID,State','-P'],text=True)
rows=[line.strip().split('|') for line in accounting.splitlines() if line.strip()]
assert {row[0] for row in rows}=={'19425444_'+str(i) for i in range(4)}, accounting
assert all(row[1]=='COMPLETED' for row in rows),accounting
for i,arm in enumerate(arms):
 q=json.loads((r/('probe-'+arm)/'JOINT_QUALIFIED.json').read_text())
 assert q['contract']['code_commit']==producer and q['resume_verified']
 assert q['resume_evidence']['deterministic_reference_bitwise_exact']
 io=json.loads((r/('probe-'+arm)/'IO_EQUIVALENT.json').read_text())
 assert io['cpu_arrays_exact'] and io['observation_prepared_and_coverage_exact']
 perf=json.loads((r/'performance'/arm/'PERFORMANCE_COMPLETE.json').read_text())
 assert perf['producer']==producer and perf['utilization_gate_passed'] and perf['gpu_utilization_mean']>=50
 assert perf['warmup_updates']==20 and perf['measured_updates']==80 and not perf['promote_diagnostic_weights']
 m=migration['migrations'][i];assert m['arm']==arm and m['producer']==producer
 assert m['all_other_checkpoint_state_exact'] and m['source_unchanged']
 assert m['global_step']==[1800,1836,758,746][i]==perf['initial_step']
 digest=hashlib.sha256()
 with (r/arm/'joint-last.pt').open('rb') as f:
  for chunk in iter(lambda:f.read(8*1024*1024),b''):digest.update(chunk)
 assert digest.hexdigest()==m['destination_sha256']
env=os.environ.copy();env.update(SAMUDRA_IMAGE=p['image'],SAMUDRA_DATA_BIND='/scratch:/scratch',APPTAINER_CACHEDIR='/scratch/jr7309/apptainer-cache',SINGULARITY_CACHEDIR='/scratch/jr7309/singularity-cache',GPU_ENABLED='1',WANDB_MODE='offline')
cmd=['sbatch','--parsable','--account=torch_pr_347_lzanna','--partition=rtx6000_lzanna','--nodes=1','--ntasks=1','--chdir=/scratch/jr7309','--export=ALL','--gres=gpu:1','--cpus-per-task=16','--mem=192G','--array=0-3%4','--requeue','--signal=B:USR1@300','--time=24:00:00','--dependency=afterok:19425444','--job-name=early-fine-train','--output='+str(r/'logs/train-%A_%a.out'),'--error='+str(r/'logs/train-%A_%a.err'),str(code/'scripts/slurm_early_fine_engaging.sbatch'),str(r),str(code),'train',producer]
job=subprocess.check_output(cmd,env=env,text=True).strip().split(';')[0]
result={'job_id':job,'producer':producer,'command':cmd,'utilization_accounting':accounting,'production_source':'audited root/ARM checkpoints; diagnostic weights excluded'}
receipt.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result))
